messages:
Nina: heads-up — seeing a spike of 503s from eu-west1 for embeddings service since 09:12 UTC. Root cause looks like an N+1 in kv-cache drain after the last quant rollout. I want to push a hotfix (v3.2.2) with a shortened cache-drain window and an emergency feature-flag. Requesting expedited pin + canary-skip for eu-west1. Rollback criteria: >1% user 503s over 5m after deploy OR memory >85% on any pod.
Marco: +1 on rollback criteria. Can we keep one canary and fast rollout to 25% before full?
Nina: prefer skip canary to reduce exposure window but will accept a single canary pod if ops needs it. asking for quick ops sign-off. @Marco would you take on canary watch?
Marco: I can watch. I'll attach a quick smoke script and alert thresholds.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: hotfix/embeds-3.2.2 -> target eu-west1. Canary: 1 pod (manual), rollout to 25% in 2m, full in 5m. Click to approve: https://deploy.redwood.internal/approve/ABCD1234
Ophelia: Are release notes ready? Need a short blurb for customers. Also what telemetry to include for postmortem?
Nina: short RN: "fix kv-cache drain causing intermittent 503s for embeddings in eu-west1". Telemetry: per-region 5xx, pod memory, kv cache hit rate, request latency p50/p95.
Jun: Risk question — does this change model weights/outputs or only infra/cache behavior? If infra-only, lower risk for semantic regressions.
Eli: infra-only. Patch toggles backoff in cache drain and pins config key `embeds.kv.drain_ms` -> 50. No model artifacts touched.
Nina: ok fast approval flow: ops (Marco) + eng (Eli) + PM (Jun) = go. Please respond with ":+1:" to approve expedited deploy skip-canary.
Marco: :+1: will monitor smoke.
Eli: :+1: patch pushed to artifact repo: `artifacts/embeds/3.2.2-hotfix` (sha: f1e2d3).
Jun: :+1: Product agrees. Notify support and put RN in support notes.
Nina: approving deploybot link now. Will add rollback runbook to thread.
Nina: Rollback playbook: 1) deploy-bot abort + pin previous version 3.2.1 2) add `embeds.kv.drain_ms`=200 (safe) 3) force eviction of offending pod and restart 4) open incident with severity=high if >1% 503s after 5m.
deploy-bot: Action: starting canary (1/1) at 6100001260. Canary health: healthy.
Marco: Canary OK at 6100001280. Advancing to 25% rollout. Monitoring logs for 503 spikes and memory.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 25% complete at 6100001295.
Ophelia: RN posted to #support-notes and customer-facing doc updated.
Eli: adding k8s one-liner to thread for quick manual rollback if needed: ```kubectl rollout undo deployment/embeds-service --to-revision=3```
Marco: seeing slight uptick in latency but 503 count trending down.
Nina: good. full rollout in 2m unless anyone objects.
Jun: no objections.
Marco: full rollout started at 6100001350.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete at 6100001365. All pods running v3.2.2. Health checks passing.
Nina: thanks team. I'll open a short postmortem and schedule a follow-up to audit the cache drain code. If anyone sees regressions, ping me immediately. :thumbsup:
